REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for congestive heart failure, 2 weeks after diuretic adjustment.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports mild increase in leg swelling over the past few days, denies weight gain tracking, denies chest pain.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Bilateral lower extremity pitting edema to the mid-shin, mild bibasilar crackles on lung auscultation, jugular venous distension noted.

ASSESSMENT: Congestive heart failure, possible mild decompensation.

PLAN: Increase diuretic dose, daily weight monitoring, follow up in 1 week or sooner if worsening.
